$comment: Authoritative package-boundary and dependency-direction graph for the FixMyFeed monorepo. Source of truth for T000. Enforced by tests/boundaries.test.mjs. Derived from docs/04-system-architecture/monorepo-architecture.md and reference-architecture.md. Adding an edge requires an approved documentation change (see AGENTS.md).

invariants.domainIsPure: The 'domain' package MUST NOT declare any internal or third-party runtime dependency (no framework, database-driver, HTTP, or provider SDK code).
invariants.connectorsNotUi: Connector packages MUST NOT depend on application UI ('ui').
invariants.noAppAsDependency: No package or app may depend on an application workspace (apps are deploy leaves).
invariants.acyclic: The internal dependency graph MUST be acyclic; dependency cycles are release-blocking.
invariants.allowListConformance: Each workspace's declared internal dependencies MUST be a subset of its allowedDependencies entry.
